_doc: Health score and verdict rules, user-editable. The runner reads this file by default (rules/scoring.json); can also be specified with --scoring <path>; falls back to built-in defaults if missing.

weights._doc: Weight of each severity in the health score. health score = Σ(weight × score) / Σ(weight).

_binarize_doc: Checker types listed here are scored 'all-or-nothing' in the health score: pass=1.0, fail=0.0 (ignore progress / partial credit). By default Milestone gives progress credit (e.g. 2/3=0.67); adding it to this list changes it to 0 when not fully satisfied. To restore progress credit, remove 'Milestone' from the list.

verdict._doc: Verdict logic. If any fail condition holds → FAIL; otherwise if any weak condition holds → WEAK_PASS; otherwise PASS.
